description: Baseline for the @insimul/core STANDALONE check (scripts/check-core-standalone.mjs, US-1 of 93-runtime-logic-to-core). Counts may only GROW; a drop means suites stopped being discoverable from within the package. Update this file (with a reason) only when suites are deliberately removed.
